text: Thomas A. Van Meter (April 22, 1943 – March 7, 1992) was a member of the Ohio General Assembly. He served in the Ohio Senate from 1973 to 1982, representing the 19th District. He sought the Republican nomination for governor in 1978 but lost to former Ohio Governor Jim Rhodes. He later returned to the General Assembly, serving one term in the Ohio House of Representatives. In 1982, he ran for the Republican nomination, finishing third to Bud Brown. He died of cancer in 1992. This article about a member of the Ohio State Senate is a stub.
